name: Alcaldía de Tunja
body: One-year HSTS, nosniff, and framing limited to its origin. But the HTML holds 21 characters of text under the title Territoriales; the rest is drawn by JavaScript, which most AI crawlers do not run.
lesson: Render the title, a description, and the main text on the server, so crawlers and AI answers can read them.
summary: www.tunja-boyaca.gov.co scores 72 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 8 pass. Fix first: plain http serves the site without redirecting.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page
fix.evidence: The HTML carries 0 characters of readable text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.
fix.fix: Render the main content on the server or pre-render it at build time.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: The TLS certificate expires in 22 days
fix.evidence: Valid until 2026-11-12, issued by ZeroSSL GmbH.
fix.fix: Confirm that automatic renewal is scheduled.

fix.title: 1 page has no meta description
fix.evidence: /. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 304 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
